notes: Recordings improvements: (1) the info panel and the camera checkbox no longer appear while reviewing footage; (2) clicking a moment on the timeline starts playing faster (no video reload); (3) synchronized playback now lets each camera play its OWN time independently, with a new 'Ortak cubuk' (common bar) that snaps them all to the same moment when you click it; (4) the sync timelines are more compact so they don't crowd out the video.
